bio.text: Robert Rivas took the oath of office as Speaker of the California State Assembly on June 30, 2023; he was first elected to the Assembly in 2018.
Before becoming Speaker he chaired the Assembly Agriculture Committee and was Vice-Chair of the Latino Legislative Caucus.
He is a lifelong resident of the 29th Assembly District, was raised in Paicines, and served two terms on the San Benito County Board of Supervisors before joining the Assembly.
